창세기 30:1.content: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

창세기 30:2.content: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

창세기 30:3.content: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

창세기 30:4.content: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

창세기 30:5.content: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

창세기 30:6.content: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

창세기 30:7.content: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

창세기 30:8.content: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

창세기 30:9.content: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

창세기 30:10.content: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

창세기 30:11.content: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

창세기 30:12.content: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

창세기 30:13.content: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

창세기 30:14.content: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

창세기 30:15.content: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

창세기 30:16.content: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

창세기 30:17.content: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

창세기 30:18.content: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

창세기 30:19.content: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

창세기 30:20.content: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

창세기 30:21.content: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

창세기 30:22.content: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

창세기 30:23.content: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

창세기 30:24.content: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.

창세기 30:25.content: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

창세기 30:26.content: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

창세기 30:27.content: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.

창세기 30:28.content: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

창세기 30:29.content: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

창세기 30:30.content: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

창세기 30:31.content: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

창세기 30:32.content: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

창세기 30:33.content: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

창세기 30:34.content: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

창세기 30:35.content: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

창세기 30:36.content: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

창세기 30:37.content: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

창세기 30:38.content: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

창세기 30:39.content: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

창세기 30:40.content: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

창세기 30:41.content: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

창세기 30:42.content: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

창세기 30:43.content: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
